# dsh-font-wheel
**Hold Ctrl and scroll the mouse wheel anywhere in the DeepSeek Harness workspace to change the font
trl and scroll the mouse wheel anywhere in the DeepSeek Harness workspace to change the font size.**

- Scroll up = bigger, scroll down = smaller, **1px per notch**
- A small `16px` pill follows the cur

sor and fades out after a second; at the ends of the range it says `已到上限` / `已到下限`
- The gesture's d

efault action is suppressed, so the page itself never zooms
- Range follows the built-in `ui-theme`

font-size specs (text 10–22px, code 10–16px, terminal 10–20px)
- Text, code and terminal move togeth
er — the exact same call the desktop app's Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- uses — and the value is persisted by `ui-
theme`'s settings, so it survives a reload

## How it works

`--dsh-content-font-size` is not yours to write. The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`
presenter p
ushes every theme snapshot back onto `body`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

So poking the CSS variable directly gets overwritten on the next snapshot. This plugin
goes through
the theme service instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Because it is the same entry point the built-in shortcut uses, the two never disagree.
Only when no

theme service is reachable (a host without UI services, a test harness)
does it fall back to writing

`--dsh-content-font-size` on `body` — there is no presenter
there to overwrite it.

The client half is a hand-written CommonJS bundle loaded through
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id,

factory })`. **No build step**, no bundler, no
dependencies: what you read in `lib/client.js` is wh

})`. **No build step**, no bundler, no
dependencies: what you read in `lib/client.js` is what runs.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then **restart the app once**. A brand-new bundle row is inserted into the profile's
composition but

is not hot-mounted in the running session (the plugin manager reports
this as `state: "restart"`);

after the restart it loads normally and later edits only
need a page refresh.
Without the CLI, two manual steps are enough:

1. in the profile's `package.json`
- add `"dsh-font-wheel": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-font-wheel"`

to `dependencies`
- append `"dsh-font-wheel"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
2. run `pnpm install` inside
the profile directory
The bundled helper does both and backs up the profile file first:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Is it alive?

Font-size changes happen in a browser event handler, so the host never sees them. The
host half ther

efore keeps one in-memory route the client pings on every step — handy
when you cannot look at the s

keeps one in-memory route the client pings on every step — handy
when you cannot look at the screen:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Nothing is written to disk, and if the host half is absent this is just a 404.
## Tuning
Constants live at the top of `lib/client.js`:
| Constant | Default | Meaning |
| `STEP_INTERVAL_MS` | `55` | Minimum ms between two steps. A trackpad gesture fires dozens of `whee

l` events; unthrottled you hit the ceiling instantly. |
| `HUD_IDLE_MS` | `1000` | How long the pill

stays after the last scroll. |
| `HUD_OFFSET_Y` | `28` | Pill offset above the cursor. |
| `TEXT_VA
RIABLE` | `--dsh-content-font-size` | Variable written by the fallback path. |

- **Only inside the conversation area?** listen on the message container instead of
`view` in `insta

ll()`, or bail out early with
`if (event.target.closest("[data-...]") === null) return`.
- **Wheel o

nly touches prose, not code/terminal?** replace
`service.adjustFontSizes(delta)` in `stepFontSize()`

with
`service.setFontSize("text", next)` (clamp the range yourself).
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No browser and no install: the client bundle is evaluated against a minimal
`window` / `document` /

theme-service stub, asserting listener options
(`capture`, non-`passive`), Ctrl-only matching, the p

revented default, throttling,
range hints, the no-service fallback, the report ping and teardown. Th

e host half runs
against a fake `ctx` and fake `req`/`res`: registration shape, `POST`/`GET` round-t

rip,
404 / 400 paths, and that disposing the effect removes the route.
## Compatibility

- Verified against DeepSeek Harness desktop on Windows; the web build uses the same
client bundle co

ntract.
- Primary path needs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme` (settings namespace `ui-theme`).
Wit

hout it the plugin still changes the size via the CSS variable, it just will not
persist or sync wit

h the settings UI.
- `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, so it loads in the browser/renderer, not in the

settings UI.
- `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, so it loads in the browser/renderer, not in the host.
## Non-goals

- No global hotkeys are registered — `shortcuts` is left alone, so nothing competes with
the built-i

n Ctrl+=.
- No other plugin's styles are touched, no theme is replaced, no model requests are made.
- The only write is the one `ui-theme` already owns.

按住 Ctrl 滚鼠标滚轮 → 调 DSH 工作区字号。

- 上滚放大，下滚缩小，一格 **1px**（和桌面端 Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- 同一条路）
- 字号范围沿用 `ui-theme` 的三档规格：text 档 10–22px，到边界提示「已到上

限 / 已到下限」
- 光标旁边浮一个小药丸显示当前 px，1 秒后自己淡掉
- 手势期间 Ctrl+滚轮的默认动作被拦下，页面本身不会跟着缩放
- text / code / terminal 三档
一起动，值由 `ui-theme` 的 settings 持久化，刷新后还是这个字号
